**CDIF**
Definition ==========
PROV-O native provenance activity building block for CDIF. Extends the minimal prov:Activity (generatedBy) with W3C PROV-O properties for comprehensive provenance documentation. Uses schema.org fallbacks only where PROV-O has no equivalent (name, description, instrument, methodology, status). :title: "PROV-O Provenance Activity" :rdfType: ``prov:Activity`` :typeDescription: "Must include prov:Activity. Unlike cdifProvActivity, does not require schema:Action dual typing." :typeOptional: :noId: :extends:

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
Human-readable name for the activity (schema.org fallback -- PROV-O has no name property) :jsonName: "schema:name"

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
Text description of what this activity did (schema.org fallback -- PROV-O has no description property) :jsonName: "schema:description"

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
Entities produced by this activity (inverse of prov:wasGeneratedBy)

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
Agents responsible for this activity (PROV-O native -- maps to schema:agent in cdifProvActivity)

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
Other activities that communicated information to this one (PROV-O activity-to-activity chain -- maps to schema:object in cdifProvActivity)

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
ISO8601 date-time when the activity started (PROV-O native -- maps to schema:startTime in cdifProvActivity)

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
ISO8601 date-time when the activity ended (PROV-O native -- maps to schema:endTime in cdifProvActivity)

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
Location where the activity occurred (PROV-O expanded term -- maps to schema:location in cdifProvActivity)

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
Status of this activity (schema.org fallback -- no PROV-O equivalent) :jsonName: "schema:actionStatus"

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
Methodology or protocol for this activity (schema.org fallback -- PROV-O has prov:hadPlan only inside qualified Association) :jsonName: "schema:actionProcess"

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
Error description for failed activities (schema.org fallback -- no PROV-O equivalent) :jsonName: "schema:error"
